title: ISO 20022 Remittance Data Enrichment Validator
description: Validate structured remittance information in ISO 20022 pain.001 and camt.054 messages. Check ISO 11649 SCR format, RmtInf/Strd population, invoice reconciliation completeness, and ERP auto-match eligibility. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.
